subject: Rescheduling my call and the missing attachment
text: Dear Professor, I am very sorry for the late message, and I also forgot the attachment, which was the draft outline I meant to send before our call, so please ignore the first version if it does not appear. I am a little confused about whether Wednesday is still better, because my club meeting moved again after the hallway discussion with the coordinator, and I suddenly remembered that I promised to bring the sign-up sheet. If the original time is inconvenient, I can move it to Friday afternoon, although I have a small commitment near three, or Tuesday before noon, if that helps. Sorry again for the messy request, and I will attach the document properly this time unless you prefer a short message first. I appreciate your patience while I sort the schedule out. I realize this is becoming a chain of small corrections, and I would rather apologize now than send another incomplete note later today or tomorrow morning.
